mapper.select: SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.code = 'default' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_permission perm WHERE perm.is_deleted = 0 AND perm.type IN ('menu', 'button') ) ELSE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_tenant_package_permission tpp INNER JOIN sys_permission perm ON perm.id = tpp.permission_id AND perm.is_deleted = 0 WHERE tpp.package_id = p.id AND tpp.is_deleted = 0 AND perm.type IN ('menu', 'button') ) END AS permission_count FROM sys_tenant_package p ${ew.customSqlSegment}
